summary: Newsletters can now send from apespetcare.org.uk, apesshelter.org.uk and myapes.me.uk as well as apesnews.org.uk, each through its own Mailgun domain, and admins can prove each one works with a test email.
detailed_changes: Newsletters send through the Mailgun HTTP API using the Mailgun domain of their From domain, such as mail.apespetcare.org.uk or news.myapes.me.uk, instead of one shared sending domain. A From domain that is not approved and enabled is refused, and system and account emails still send from apesnews.org.uk (#560).

apespetcare.org.uk, apesshelter.org.uk and myapes.me.uk are added as approved sending domains with their news@ and noreply@ From addresses (news@news.myapes.me.uk only for myapes.me.uk). They stay pending until their Mailgun and DNS set-up is finished (#599).
Admins manage each domain's allowed From addresses and a default reply-to on Admin → Settings → Email sending domains, and staff now pick a newsletter's From address from that list (#599).

Every domain and From address has a Send test email button. It sends straight away to the signed-in admin and one optional extra address, shows Mailgun's message ID or error, and re-checks Active, SPF, DKIM and DMARC (#600).

Only admins can manage sending domains and send tests, after confirming their identity. Every change and test is written to the audit log, and test emails are limited to 5 a minute per admin and 20 a day per domain (#601).
Automated tests cover per-domain routing for all four domains, test-send success and failure, permissions, limits and audit logging, with no real calls to Mailgun (#602).
affected_areas: User groups affected: admins and super admins (sending domains), staff editing newsletters (From address list)
Public impact: newsletter emails can come from the new domains once they are verified; no change to public pages

Internal impact: new email_sender_addresses table, Mailgun HTTP API transport for newsletters (MAILING_NEWSLETTER_TRANSPORT=smtp switches back to Cloudron SMTP), sending-domain-test rate limiter, ops runbook in docs/email-sending-domains.md
